entities.name: PMID:25078870
observations: 2014 experimental study tested NDV/FMW with autophagy modulation in cisplatin-resistant A549/DDP and paclitaxel-resistant A549/PTX lung cancer models.

entities.name: CQ enhances NDV in A549/DDP
observations: In cisplatin-resistant A549/DDP cells and corresponding mouse tumors, autophagy inhibition with chloroquine potentiated NDV/FMW antitumor activity; ATG5 knockdown also enhanced activity.
Autophagy modulation did not increase viral progeny, so increased virus yield did not explain enhanced oncolysis.

entities.name: Rapamycin enhances NDV in A549/PTX
observations: In paclitaxel-resistant A549/PTX cells and corresponding mouse tumors, rapamycin-mediated autophagy induction potentiated NDV/FMW oncolytic activity.
NDV/FMW induced autophagy in A549/PTX, associated with dampened PI3K/Akt/mTOR/p70S6K signaling; modulation did not increase viral progeny.

entities.name: Chloroquine
observations: Used as an autophagy inhibitor to potentiate NDV/FMW antitumor activity in cisplatin-resistant A549/DDP cells and tumors (PMID:25078870).

entities.name: Rapamycin
observations: Used as an autophagy inducer to potentiate NDV/FMW oncolytic activity in paclitaxel-resistant A549/PTX cells and tumors (PMID:25078870).
